title: Fairness-Constrained Load-Shedding Optimisation with Cold Load Pickup: Ambient Temperature versus Outage Duration as Surge Drivers in a Chronically Constrained Grid
description:
Reproducibility package for the study of cold-load-pickup (CLPU) surge drivers in rotational load shedding, built on SCADA telemetry from five Iraqi governorates (206,040 hourly records, 2020-2024).

Contents: the fairness-constrained multi-scenario MILP (Eqs. 1-18), per-governorate BiLSTM demand forecasting with LSTM, GRU and XGBoost benchmarks, the five model configurations S1-S5 across six thermal regimes, solver-gap diagnostics and lower bounds for all thirty instances, the thermal-kernel sensitivity analysis, the scenario-convergence and fairness-tolerance studies, the budget-stability re-solves, and the discomfort-weighting robustness re-solves.

The raw SCADA records are governed by a Ministry of Electricity confidentiality arrangement and are not redistributed. Only derived and aggregated artefacts sufficient to verify the reported findings are included.
